references.text: The Lord promises to lead the Israelites into the land of Canaan and drive out the nations living there
Moses reminds the people that they must cross the Jordan and take possession of the land from peoples greater and stronger than them
Moses tells them that they will cross the Jordan to take possession of the land the Lord gives them
Describes the crossing of the Jordan into the land where they will live in safety
Joshua is commanded to cross the Jordan with all the people into the land the Lord gives them
The fulfillment of the promise when the Israelites actually crossed the Jordan on dry ground
God's original promise to Abraham to give the land of Canaan to his descendants
God's covenant with Abraham to give the land of Canaan as an eternal possession
The Lord promises to lead the Israelites out of Egypt and into the land of Canaan
